operations.what: attention of one query over each partition of its keys with the partition's log-sum-exp, and the partials merged into the full result
operations.verify: on the target, compute two partitions' partials and their merge with the kernels and with attention_partial and merge_partials: outputs within BF16 probability rounding, log-sum-exps within FP32 error
operations.invariance: the merged result independent of where the partitions are cut, within the tolerance; the same bits on a repeat
